settings.label: Power watcher state
settings.description: Optional state.json written by the `power` watcher. It adds measured draw, warnings and top consumers; a stale file is ignored.

actions.title: Open Battery settings
actions.description: Battery settings on macOS; the available power settings application on Linux.

power.description: The live battery gauge and, when available, the `power` watcher's measured draw, warnings, consumers and wake locks.

draw.description: Measured draw in watts from the power watcher; 0 without it

alert.description: The power watcher's worst warning: crit, warn, or nothing

battery.title: Battery
battery.description: Battery level, and the time left once that is the question being asked. Hidden while healthy by its rules: on battery from 50%, on the charger from 20%, unless the power watcher warns or measures a draw of 15 W. Amber at 20%, red at 10% or on a critical warning. Click opens Battery Settings; its popover explains the live draw and culprits when the power watcher is available.

rules.description: On battery with plenty left and nothing wrong: nothing to say.
